summary.text: Nancy DeBoer is a Republican member of the Michigan House of Representatives, first elected in November 2022, representing District 86, which encompasses the greater Holland area.
She chairs the House Education and Workforce Committee and was Holland's mayor from 2015 to 2019.

paragraphs.text: DeBoer graduated from Calvin College with a bachelor's degree in secondary education and began her career as a middle and high school English teacher.
In 2002 she co-founded the West Michigan Character Council and served as its executive director for 17 years.
She was a member of the Holland City Council starting in 2005 and became the first woman elected mayor of Holland in 2015, serving two terms through 2019.
In the House she also serves on the Energy, Health Policy and Rules committees.
